description: Angular component for selecting and configuring date formats in a widget setting, including popover dialogs for custom and auto date format configurations.

classes.name: DateFormatSelectComponent
classes.description: Angular component for selecting date formats with popover configuration dialogs.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up date format list and form control with value change subscription.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current value of the date format model and updates the form control.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model and propagates change if the new value differs.

methods.name: dateFormatDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns a display string for the current date format, using translation and caching.

methods.name: openDateFormatSettingsPopup
methods.description: Opens a popover for editing date format settings.

methods.name: openAutoFormatSettingsPopup
methods.description: Opens a popover for editing auto date format settings.
